from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
def test_catalogo_repository_uses_pymssql_placeholders():
    s=(ROOT/'backend/modules/catalogo_ampliado/repository.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert '?' not in s
    assert '%s' in s

name: Catalogo Ampliado Gate6 E2E Development
on:
  push:
    branches: [Edarsahub_Desarrollo]
    paths:
      - ops/e2e/requests/CATALOGO-AMPLIADO-GATE6-R3-20260908.execute
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST: 54.39.104.176
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT: 1433
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE: EDARSAHUB
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
      JWT_SECRET: gate6-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.sha }}
      ENV: development
      CATALOGO_GATE6_REAL: 1
      GATE6_EVIDENCE_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/gate6/evidence.json
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Install backend runtime
        run: python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
      - name: Navigation and frontend build
        run: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && grep -q 'path="catalogo-ampliado"' frontend/src/App.js && grep -q 'CatalogoAmpliadoDashboard' frontend/src/App.js
      - name: Real API SQL E2E
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/backend
        run: mkdir -p $RUNNER_TEMP/gate6 && python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_catalogo_ampliado_gate6_e2e_real.py
      - name: Manifest
        if: always()
        run: mkdir -p $RUNNER_TEMP/gate6 && printf '%s\n' run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID commit=$GITHUB_SHA production_touched=false > $RUNNER_TEMP/gate6/manifest.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: catalogo-ampliado-gate6-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/gate6
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
def read(p): return (ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
def test_gate6_contract():
 repo=read('backend/modules/catalogo_ampliado/repository.py'); e2e=read('backend/tests/test_catalogo_ampliado_gate6_e2e_real.py'); wf=read('.github/workflows/catalogo-ampliado-gate6-e2e.yml')
 assert '?' not in repo and '%s' in repo
 assert 'NIVEL_ACCESO_TOTAL' in e2e and 'cleanup' in e2e and 'residue' in e2e
 for x in ('/personas','/vinculos','/documentos','/versiones','/kardex','/vencimientos','/alertas/reglas'): assert x in e2e
 assert 'environment: development' in wf and 'Edarsahub_Produccion' not in wf and 'production_touched=false' in wf
